nuggets.text: JJ Buchanan, one of five players who followed Kyle Whittingham from Utah, caught the Wolverines' winning touchdown in the opener.
Wolverines QB Tommy Carr's grandfathers are former Michigan coach Lloyd Carr and Michigan All-American Tom Curtis.
Wolverines coach Kyle Whittingham played linebacker at BYU, then in the USFL for the Denver Gold and New Orleans Breakers.
Wolverines coach Kyle Whittingham led Utah to a perfect 13-0 season in 2008.
The Wolverines have drawn more than 100,000 fans to every home game since November 8, 1975.
The Wolverines' stadium has one famous extra seat: 101,001 in 1956, said to be reserved for athletic director Fritz Crisler.
Most of Michigan Stadium's seats are below ground level, so its true size is hard to see from outside.
The Wolverines' winged helmet debuted in 1938, ostensibly to help players find receivers downfield.
The Wolverines and Minnesota play for the Little Brown Jug, college football's oldest rivalry trophy, dating to 1903.
